item.title: Unitree Plants ‘Three Bases, Two Centers’ in Chengdu as Embodied-AI Leaders Converge
item.description: Unitree is setting up a “three bases, two centers” embodied-intelligence footprint in Chengdu, making it the fifth leading Chinese embodied-AI company to establish a presence in the southwestern tech hub.

item.title: China’s Lithium-Ion Battery Shipments Could Top 3,600 GWh by 2030, Academician Forecasts
item.description: Academician Ouyang Minggao forecast at the 2026 World Power Battery Conference that China’s lithium-ion battery shipments will exceed 3,600 GWh by 2030, as safety, AI and recycling reshape the sector.

item.title: China Gives Robot-Assisted Surgery Its Own Reimbursement Group to Complete the Pricing Puzzle
item.description: China’s National Healthcare Security Administration has carved robot-assisted surgery into its own reimbursement group in the DRG/DIP 3.0 plan, closing a pricing gap that could otherwise penalize hospitals adopting surgical robots.

item.title: Zhipu AI Puts Token Subscriptions on Tmall, Pushing Model Usage Into Consumer Retail
item.description: Zhipu AI has opened a Tmall flagship store selling GLM Coding Plan token subscriptions, the first time a listed large-model company has put its core AI product on a mainstream e-commerce shelf.

item.title: Fullive.ai’s AI Bedside Sleep Device Somni Backs a Bet on ‘Response Learning’
item.description: Fullive.ai, an AI hardware startup founded under a year ago, has wrapped three funding rounds as it readies its first bedside sleep device Somni — a screen-less lamp that learns how users respond to night-time interventions, a step toward an AI “response model.”
